{{Quote|The rebels! Free Onderon!|The Citizen|<ref name="FR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' lived on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] during the period when [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] affiliated the planet with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] struck in [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] and destroyed the city power generator, they won this man's support.<ref name="FR" />

The citizen also was also in attendance at the planned [[Attempted execution of Ramsis Dendup and Saw Gerrera/Legends|execution of Ramsis Dendup and Saw Gerrera]].<ref name="TSW">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref>
